User chose to spike before deciding.

blockers.description: sklearn 1.8.0 removed CalibratedClassifierCV(cv='prefit'). CONTEXT.md skeleton code at lines 316-319 uses prefit pattern → InvalidParameterError at runtime. Must use manual LogisticRegression (Platt) / IsotonicRegression on raw predict_proba.
blockers.workaround: Researcher provided manual calibration pattern in 07-RESEARCH.md Pattern 2. Planner must adopt this; CONTEXT.md skeleton needs revising during planning.

blockers.description: Fold size reality: 1,076 rows / 10 folds → fold-1 val ≈ 20 rows. Isotonic on val<50 unreliable.
blockers.workaround: Use Platt only for early folds (val<50); apply Brier-winner picking from fold ≥3 onward. Decision deferred to spike outcome — if Option A re-run yields 10k+ rows, this is moot.

decisions.rationale: Researcher surfaced critical dataset gap as Wave 0 blocker. User chose to spike rather than have planner pick remediation strategy. Avoids committing plan structure to a path that may not work.

Researcher benchmarked WSL2 Docker p50=4ms / p95=9ms / p99=13ms. p99 jitter from OS scheduling. Locking p99<10ms would force smaller model (lower n_estimators or num_leaves) → lower accuracy ceiling. p95 over 1000-sample benchmark accepted.
